subject: [PATCH v9 25/32] mm/mincore: report PMD swap-cache residency

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mincore function where it incorrectly reports pages as resident when they are actually swapped out. The patch introduces a new function, mincore_pmd_swap, which checks if a PMD swap entry is present and returns residency information accordingly. If the PMD swap entry is huge, it directly returns residency information for all pages covered by the folio. Otherwise, it falls back to checking each individual slot as before. This patch also adds a new function, mincore_pmd_swap, which handles PMD swap entries in the absence of CONFIG_THP_SWAP. The patch aims to improve the accuracy of mincore's reporting and prevent unnecessary page faults.
